ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white) to 60% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity white contiguous regions are located on the distal halves of both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation is dominant in the central peduncle area and forms a thick continuous band along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated acute angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge displays high-frequency micro-serrations with several distinct irregular macro-notches on the right lobe; continuous linear boundary isolated from water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex trajectory sweeping from the median notch toward sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (barnacles) on the distal tips of both lobes; faint circular ring-shaped scars visible on the low-intensity central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical parallel dark linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle colonization on both outer lobe tips and multiple circular scars near the median notch junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy black speckled mottling localized within the distal white regions, most prominent on the inferior edge of the right lobe white patch.
